name: GhostScrollArea
description: Headless native overflow container. useGhostScrollArea owns overflow measurement, tabindex policy, and data-type hooks; GhostScrollArea is the scroll root with a default slot. Native keyboard scrolling is left to the platform. Themed recipes live on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: as
props.description: Scroll root host. Closed union; only div is supported initially.

props.name: label
props.description: When the root is a tab stop with no inner focusables, sets role=region and aria-label.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which axes may scroll when content exceeds the box.

props.name: type
props.description: Native overflow mode on enabled axes: auto or scroll.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Scrollable content inside the native overflow root.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Native overflow host. data-orientation and data-type configure axes; data-overflow reflects measured overflow (none, vertical, horizontal, both).

attributes.name: data-orientation
attributes.description: Resolved orientation on the root. Always present.
